description: This is a zero gravity chair, designed for ultimate relaxation. It features a sturdy metal frame that allows it to recline to a near-flat position, mimicking the sensation of weightlessness. The seat and back are made of durable fabric panels in earthy tones of olive green and grey, connected with a lacing system for adjustable tension and comfort. The chair includes padded armrests for added comfort and a plush, grey sherpa blanket draped over the backrest, suggesting cozy use. It is presented on a natural wood slab, highlighting its outdoor or rustic appeal.
